column8: Flight Crew Executed Go Around / Missed Approach
column9:
At 14:20 we were cleared for the visual approach to RWY 28R.
At 14:23 TCAS issued an RA and we stopped the descent.
At 14:25 we executed a go around as instructed by tower.

column8: Air Traffic Control Issued New Clearance
column9:
At 09:05 ground gave us taxi via Alpha to RWY 16L.
At 09:07 we held short of the runway as the hold bars were lit.
At 09:09 we continued after supervisor approval was relayed.

At 31:10 the autopilot captured the wrong altitude.
At 31:12 we rerouted the climb profile and advised center.

During the rollout an amber caution illuminated.
We halted the turnoff and requested a tow.
The cabin was secured and the service commenced normally.

At 22:40 we received a traffic alert.
At 22:41 we stopped the descent and turned right.
At 22:44 we proceeded on course.
